subject: Re: Redwood billing requirements and PO process — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood follow-up: invoice & PO details (Acme)

Hi Laura / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the discovery call earlier today — really appreciate the clear context on your approval flow. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get the commercial path moving: 

- Procurement preference: you mentioned internal preference for Purchase Order (PO) rather than card. Confirming Redwood accepts PO?
- Net terms: you said you'll request Net 30 from AP — can you confirm the exact term (Net 30 / Net 45)?
- Invoice delivery: do you need invoices uploaded to Ariba / Coupa or is emailed PDF to ap@acme.com acceptable?
- Invoice details: please confirm whether we should include a VAT number on the invoice (if applicable), your billing address, and any required line-item format (e.g., separate line for reserved capacity + overage).
- Marketplace: you flagged interest in purchasing via AWS Marketplace later — please confirm if you'd like us to pursue listing or if direct PO is fine for initial purchase.

I've attached an exec summary of the proposed SOW for reference (Acme-SOW-Exec-Summary.pdf). Once we have the above details I can loop our billing operations to generate the correct invoice and vendor paperwork.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm billing address, VAT/DUNS (if needed), and preferred invoice channel
2) We provide vendor paperwork (W-9 / vendor enrollment) and a quote/PI that includes PO-friendly fields
3) Your AP issues PO and we invoice with PO number on header

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: Acme-SOW-Exec-Summary.pdf

From: Laura Mills <laura.mills@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Team <ap@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood follow-up: invoice & PO details (Acme)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the summary — good plan. Answers below: 

- We will use a PO for the first order. Please include a field for PO number on the face of the invoice; our AP team requires it for processing.
- Net terms: Net 30 preferred.
- Invoice delivery: we prefer invoices uploaded to Ariba (we can route to a connector). If you cannot upload to Ariba, email PDF to ap@acme.com is acceptable (include PO number in subject).
- VAT / Tax: Acme VAT ID is ACME-VAT-12345. For US invoices VAT won’t apply but please include Tax ID / VAT field for international invoices.
- Billing address: Acme Corporation
  Attn: Accounts Payable
  800 Market St, Floor 20
  San Francisco, CA 94103

- Required fields: vendor name, vendor tax id (EIN), invoice date, invoice number, PO number, line item description, unit price, quantity, total, remit-to address.

I attached our PO template (Acme_PO_template_2027.pdf) for your billing ops. Also, we are evaluating whether to purchase through AWS Marketplace — that's a separate internal track and won't block issuance of a direct PO for the pilot.

Let me know if you need Redwood's W-9 / vendor details and who to send them to.

Best,
Laura Mills
Procurement Manager | Acme Corporation
laura.mills@acme.com

Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood follow-up: invoice & PO details (Acme)

Hi team,

Thanks for the context — we can support Acme's requirements. Summary of actions from Billing Ops: 

- PO / Ariba: Redwood can receive PO numbers and process invoices via Ariba. If Acme uploads to Ariba, invoices will be routed to our AP connector. If emailed, instruct them to send PDFs to invoices@redwood.ai (cc: ap@redwood.ai).
- Net terms: Net 30 is acceptable for this deal; we will set Net 30 on the invoice and in our billing records.
- Invoice format: we will provide a PDF invoice that includes: Redwood vendor name, Redwood EIN: 12-3456789, invoice number, invoice date, PO number field, line-item breakdown (Reserved capacity + overage), unit price, quantity, tax fields, total, and remit-to info.
- Remit-to / billing address to include on invoice: Redwood Inference
  Attn: Accounts Receivable
  1200 Innovation Way
  Palo Alto, CA 94301

- Vendor paperwork: attaching Redwood_W9_2027.pdf and Vendor_Enrollment_Form.pdf. Please send these to Acme procurement and copy invoices@redwood.ai.
- Marketplace: we can support AWS Marketplace but listing timeline is separate; provide direct PO for pilot.

Turnaround: once Po number is provided, billing can issue an initial invoice within 1 business day after contract signature / PO receipt.

Let me know if you want me to send the vendor packet directly to laura.mills@acme.com.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_W9_2027.pdf, Vendor_Enrollment_Form.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, AP Team <ap@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood follow-up: invoice & PO details (Acme)

Hi Laura — thanks for the quick responses and for sending the PO template. 

Per billing ops (copied), we can accept a PO and Net 30 terms. I've attached our W-9 and vendor enrollment form so your AP team has everything they asked for. Monica confirmed we can accept Ariba uploads or emailed PDFs to ap@acme.com; invoices should include the PO number on the invoice header.

Next steps:
- If you can issue the PO, please send the PO number to ap@acme.com and cc me. Billing will issue the invoice within 1 business day of PO receipt.
- If you prefer, Monica can upload the invoice into Ariba once the connector is configured — let us know and we can coordinate the connector details.

I'll follow up in HubSpot with the updated paperwork and price table. Scheduling note: can we target the PO issuance by EOB next week so we can start the pilot the week after?

Thanks again — happy to coordinate a short sync with AP if they want to walk through the vendor onboarding steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_W9_2027.pdf, Vendor_Enrollment_Form.pdf
